body: Wire agb remote-control [repo] [--dry-run] [--json], agb status --mobile, and agb accept --mobile in bin/agb.mjs, fix resolveAgyBinary() call in lib/handoff.mjs, and update commands/agb.md and skills/agb/SKILL.md.
